topic: Classification of aircraft, arrangements of major components and their functions
syllabus_extract: Classification of aircraft, arrangements of major components and their functions
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of component diagrams; Safety: No physical handling of aircraft parts; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation
intro_questions: What are the primary categories of aircraft based on propulsion?
Name the four major structural components of an aircraft.
Define the function of the fuselage in an aircraft structure.

development.content:
Classification by propulsion type
Classification by wing configuration
Classification by landing gear
Classification by mission role
Classification by size and range

Fuselage structure and elements
Wing structure and elements
Empennage components and functions
Landing gear types and functions
Powerplant arrangement and systems

Integration of major components
Structural load paths explanation
Component interaction during flight phases
Review of specific structural elements
Summary of classification criteria

summary_questions: Explain how the wing structure supports the aircraft during flight.
Differentiate between fixed and retractable landing gear arrangements.
Describe the function of the horizontal stabilizer in aircraft control.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the design requirements for the next lesson (LP 02) focusing on how classification influences manufacturing processes.
